0.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4REWARD_00944_OSEWYDOSEWYD_000_000
0.description: I promise not to do a mischief upon you, royal sapling. This artful artisan is here to help!
0.translation_description: Non ti farò nessun dispetto, giovane germoglio regale. Questo abile artigiano è qui per aiutarti!

1.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4REWARD_00944_OSEWYD_000_010
1.description: Like I said, I make a habit of making weapons. Where you have the wherewithal, I've got the goods!
1.translation_description: Come ti dicevo, mi dedico spesso alla fabbricazione di armi. Tu porta i mezzi e io ti darò la merce!

5.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4REWARD_00944_A1_000_022
5.description: Request to keep your aetherpool gear.

9.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4REWARD_00944_OSEWYD_000_030
9.description: You want to use the king's gift <hex:021A020203>outside<hex:021A020103> of the churches? Mmm...maybe when you're older!
9.translation_description: Vuoi usare il dono del re <hex:021A020203>fuori<hex:021A020103> dalle chiese? Mmm... magari quando sarai più grande!

10.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4REWARD_00944_SYSTEM_000_031
10.description: You must clear the area beyond stone 30 and complete the subsequent quest in order to use aetherpool gear outside of Pilgrim's Traverse.
10.translation_description: Per usare l’equipaggiamento eterico fuori dalla Traversata del Pellegrino, devi completare l’area oltre la pietra 30 e poi la missione successiva.

11.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4REWARD_00944_OSEWYD_000_040
11.description: You want things already!? But you've only just started exploring... And I don't feel like working...
11.translation_description: Vuoi già qualcosa!? Hai appena iniziato a esplorare... e non ho voglia di lavorare...

12.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4REWARD_00944_SYSTEM_000_041
12.description: You must clear the area beyond traverse stone 30 and complete the subsequent quest in order to forge illumed aetherpool grips.
12.translation_description: Per forgiare impugnature eteriche illuminate, devi completare l’area oltre la pietra 30 e poi la missione successiva.

13.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4REWARD_00944_OSEWYD_000_050
13.description: Hmm... You should put the king's gift to more use, fatten it up with the fruits of victory. It looks far too frail to survive my mischief.
13.translation_description: Mmm... Dovresti usare di più il dono del re e potenziarlo con i frutti della vittoria. È troppo fragile per sopravvivere ai miei scherzi.

14.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4REWARD_00944_SYSTEM_000_051
14.description: In order to forge an illumed aetherpool grip, both your illumed aetherpool weapon and armor must have attained a minimum strength of +10.
14.translation_description: Per forgiare un’impugnatura eterica illuminata, sia l’arma eterica illuminata sia l’armatura eterica devono raggiungere una potenza minima di +10.

15.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4REWARD_00944_OSEWYD_000_052
15.description: Grand! Now to wiggle the memories of battle loose─just like working free a mortal's soul!
15.translation_description: Magnifico! Ora estrarrò i ricordi della battaglia, come si libera l’anima di un mortale!

16.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4REWARD_00944_Q2_000_053
16.description: Forge an illumed aetherpool grip?<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>※The strength of your illumed aetherpool arm and armor will be reduced by 10.<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>
16.translation_description: Vuoi forgiare un’impugnatura eterica illuminata?<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>※La potenza dell’arma e dell’armatura eteriche illuminate diminuirà di 10.<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>

18.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4REWARD_00944_A3_000_061
18.description: What is there to be found in the churches?

19.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4REWARD_00944_A3_000_062
19.description: Can aetherpool arms be used outside of the churches?
19.translation_description: Si possono usare le armi eteriche fuori dalle chiese?

21.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4REWARD_00944_OSEWYD_000_070
21.description: The ramshackle scraps of lives left behind. Pixies can weave a dream out of anything, but you mortals are so picky when it comes to gifts!
21.translation_description: I miseri resti di vite ormai trascorse. Le fate sanno tessere sogni con qualsiasi cosa, ma voi mortali siete così esigenti quando si tratta di doni!

22.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4REWARD_00944_OSEWYD_000_071
22.description: So bring me aether-rich shards from inside the church, and I'll use them to spin you glory out of glass.
22.translation_description: Portami frammenti ricchi di etere dalla chiesa e userò il vetro per forgiare qualcosa di glorioso per te.

23.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4REWARD_00944_OSEWYD_000_072
23.description: Neither will I refuse pretty pebbles or glamorous gobs. Whatever tickles my fancy will earn you an even trade!
23.translation_description: Non rifiuto sassolini graziosi o mucchietti scintillanti. Qualunque cosa mi piaccia ti frutterà uno scambio alla pari!

24.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4REWARD_00944_OSEWYD_000_080
24.description: Yes, but only with the help of Ose Wyd! The king's gift is glorious but also dangerously delicate. Left alone for long, it will become brittle as bark!
24.translation_description: Sì, ma solo con l’aiuto di Ose Wyd! Il dono del re è glorioso, ma anche molto delicato. Se resta a lungo senza cure, diventa fragile come la corteccia!

25.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4REWARD_00944_OSEWYD_000_081
25.description: That's where I come in. With a flick of the wrist, I can pluck out its strongest moments and make them last for an age─wherever and whenever you need them!
25.translation_description: E qui entro in gioco io. Con un semplice gesto posso estrarne i ricordi più intensi e farli durare per sempre, ovunque e in qualunque momento ti servano!

26.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4REWARD_00944_SYSTEM_100_081
26.description: You may use your illumed aetherpool weapon outside of Pilgrim's Traverse after clearing the area marked by stone 30 and completing the subsequent quest.
26.translation_description: Puoi usare l’arma eterica illuminata fuori dalla Traversata del Pellegrino dopo aver completato l’area segnata dalla pietra 30 e la missione successiva.

27.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4REWARD_00944_SYSTEM_000_082
27.description: However, you must first forge a sufficient number of illumed aetherpool grips.
27.translation_description: Prima, però, devi forgiare un numero sufficiente di impugnature eteriche illuminate.

28.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4REWARD_00944_SYSTEM_000_083
28.description: Forging one grip will reduce the strength of your illumed aetherpool arm and armor by 10.
28.translation_description: Ogni impugnatura forgiata riduce di 10 la potenza dell'arma e dell'armatura eteriche illuminate.

29.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4REWARD_00944_SYSTEM_000_084
29.description: Sacramental weapons may be obtained by clearing the area marked by stone 100 and enhancing your illumed aetherpool arm to +60 or above.
29.translation_description: Puoi ottenere armi sacramentali completando l’area segnata dalla pietra 100 e potenziando l’arma eterica illuminata fino a +60 o oltre.
